I lead impact measurement for YouTube’s Business Organization, guiding a team of data scientists who help executives make rigorous, data-driven decisions about YouTube’s programs and strategy.
My journey at Google began in 2019 on the Chief Economist’s team. Before joining Google, I earned my PhD in Economics from the University of Virginia and worked as a researcher at Mathematica, helping policymakers use evidence to inform education and health policy.

Focus areas: Causal inference, Bayesian statistics, experiment design, and econometric modeling.
Writing & tools: Author of Business Data Science and creator of Iggy.
Citizenship:  Argentina &  United States
